title: Inter 5–3 Udinese, from two down
description: Inter came from two goals down to beat Udinese 5–3 at San Siro. Chivu took the blame and defended his goalkeeper; Sky has Stones and Çalhanoğlu in doubt for Roma.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 14, Tuesday, September 15, 2026 — Inter 5–3 Udinese, from two down

blocks.html: Inter went two goals down at San Siro inside 16 minutes and won 5–3 with five different scorers. Cristian Chivu, Inter's coach, took the blame for the flat start and then spent his press conference defending his goalkeeper. Inter go to Roma on Saturday level at the top of Serie A, and Sky Sport Italia expects them to be without two starters.

blocks.h3: Chivu takes the blame, then defends his goalkeeper
paras: Cristian Chivu spoke at San Siro after the match. "Mi prendo la responsabilità di non aver trasmesso l'energia giusta stasera" — I take responsibility for not passing on the right energy tonight.

He then turned to his goalkeeper, Josep Martínez, who has been criticized in the Italian press. "Lo difenderò fino alla morte" — I will defend him to the death. He asked reporters to print one line: "Martinez non sarà mai un problema" — Martinez will never be a problem.
blocks.kicker: SAID · INTER.IT · SKY SPORT ITALIA · SEP 14

blocks.h3: Juventus end the Inter Women cup run
paras: Inter Women lost 1–0 to Juventus in the Serie A Women's Cup semifinal on Saturday in Biella. An own goal from Inter defender Van Diemen, in the 34th minute, settled it. Coach David Sassarini called it a good performance on a difficult field, punished by one incident.
Next for them is Häcken on September 22, Inter's first match in the UEFA Women's Champions League.

blocks.h3: Sky: Stones and Çalhanoğlu are doubts for Roma
paras: Sky Sport Italia reports that John Stones, the defender signed this summer, came off in the 62nd minute with a problem in his left hamstring. Tests are due within hours. "Le sensazioni, anche per il modo in cui è uscito, non sono positive" — the feeling, given the way he came off, is not good.
Hakan Çalhanoğlu, who missed Monday with adductor fatigue, is described as in serious doubt for the Olimpico. Inter have ruled out neither player.
blocks.kicker: SKY SPORT ITALIA VIA FCINTERNEWS · SEP 14

blocks.h3: Sport: Barcelona offered Balde for Dimarco
paras: The Spanish daily Sport reports that Barcelona wanted Federico Dimarco in the summer window. Through sporting director Deco they proposed a swap: Dimarco to Barcelona, Alejandro Balde to Inter, with a cash balance in Inter's favor. Inter refused — "non c'è mai stata nessuna apertura a questo scenario" — there was never any opening to that scenario.
Edition No. 13 carried the push to extend Dimarco to 2030. New today is the offer Inter turned down.

lines: YOUR CALL FOR TUESDAY · Chivu may be without his metronome at the Olimpico.

paras: Two goals down inside 16 minutes, and assistant coach Aleksandar Kolarov sent off in the 19th. Five different Inter players scored after that.
